Star Buds in Bricktown is the top medical cannabis dispensary serving the community of Bricktown as well as the Oklahoma County area. Come see us for all your medical marijuana needs! Our compassionate and knowledgeable staff is here to help you get exactly what you need at the best possible price, without pushy or overbearing sales tactics. We are proud to own and operate 7 medical dispensaries throughout the great state of Oklahoma. Come visit us today and see the Star Buds difference for yourself!

​

​Star Buds Bricktown Medical Weed Dispensary is proud to serve only the top medical cannabis products to customers in Oklahoma County and surrounding areas, including the communities of Amber, Arcadia, Bethany, Bethel Acres, Blanchard, Bricktown, Cashion, Choctaw, Edmond, Guthrie, Harrah, Jones, Luther, Mcloud, Meridian, Midwest City, Mustang, Newalla, Newcastle, Nicoma Park, Noble, Norman, Oklahoma City, Piedmont, Spencer, Tuttle, Union City, Wellston, Wheatland, and Yukon.
Come Visit Our Medical Marijuana Dispensary in Bricktown, Oklahoma!
Welcome to Star Buds Medical Weed Dispensary Bricktown, the best medical dispensary near you to provide only the highest quality and award-winning cannabis strains in Oklahoma.

At our core, we create a truly welcoming and unique experience unlike any other medical dispensaries in the area. We highly encourage you to take your time inside our dispensary and enjoy the ambiance of our clean and friendly cannabis store. Feel free to smell the aroma of every premium cannabis strain and inspect the trichomes on various cannabis flower. Questions about our top-notch medical cannabis products are always welcome!

Whether you have visited other dispensaries near you before or are brand new to shopping at medical marijuana dispensaries, Star Buds Bricktown has everything you could possibly need. Each budtender is knowledgeable and prepared to provide you with outstanding customer service and expert advice to help you pick out marijuana products specific to your needs. We have the best variety of medical cannabis products in the state, including a wide range of cannabis flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, edibles, tinctures, and smoking accessories. Below is our cannabis flower pricing:

Above all, we provide each customer with an outstanding and unmatched rewards program. Every customer is eligible to earn reward points that count towards savings on various marijuana products! Stop by our location, or order online, to pick up in-store or curbside anytime Sunday through Thursday from 12:00 PM to 12:00 AM and Saturday and Sunday from 12:00 PM to 2:30 AM. Come see why Star Buds Medical Weed Dispensary Bricktown shines high above the rest.

​

What to Know Before You Go…

​

This is my first time visiting Star Buds. What should I bring with me?

All visitors must be at least 18 years of age with a valid Oklahoma Medical Marijuana card and must provide a valid photo ID. We take cash and debit cards, and there is also an ATM inside our dispensary for your convenience.

​

Is your dispensary open late?

We understand that normal operating hours are not always convenient for our consumers with busy lifestyles, which is why our dispensary is open every day from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM, and 8:00 AM to 2:30 AM every Friday and Saturday.

​

Does Star Buds offer any discounts or ways to save on orders?

We run product specials 7 days a week, and our loyalty rewards program offers even more savings. We are happy to provide our MED card holders and veterans with a discount upon request.

​

Read What Our Customers Are Saying!
